source_observation: collate_with_memory_limit caps record-count planning at 2 GiB when using --memory-limit; single_collation also caps tuning_budget at 2 GiB. Raising --memory-limit above 2 GiB would not change these particular settings. No larger-memory timing was run.
limitation: Phase and I/O counters localize the slowdown to gather, but do not isolate its root cause. Both sizes use spooling; no mode transition is established.
